description: Greenhouse gas emissions over the whole life of a medium-size petrol car sold in the European Union in 2025, per kilometre driven: making the car, producing and burning its fuel (the average EU blend of fossil petrol and ethanol), and maintenance. The ICCT estimates it at 235 grams of CO2-equivalent per kilometre.

Value: "estimated at 235 g CO2e/km" is published as 235 grams of CO2-equivalent per kilometre for cars sold in 2025.

published_value.quote: This is 73% lower than the emissions of gasoline ICEVs running on the average blend of fossil gasoline and ethanol, estimated at 235 g CO2e/km.

scope.basis: Sales-weighted average medium-segment car (SUVs excluded) registered in the EU in 2023, sold in 2025 and driven for 20 years on the average blend of fossil gasoline and ethanol; vehicle production and recycling, fuel production, tailpipe emissions and maintenance.

title: Life-cycle emissions of a petrol car in the EU (ICCT)
